title: Hybrid Search for the Support Desk
briefMd:
# Phase 3 · Hybrid Search for the Support Desk

The support desk asks two kinds of questions. Some name an exact model or error code ("How long is the warranty on the RT-4712?"). Others are everyday wording that shares almost no words with the policy that answers them ("How long can a mom or dad stay home with a newborn and keep getting paid?"). Pick a retrieval mode that answers both.

The knowledge base has 190 documents: product sheets and error articles that come in families of near-identical models (the model number appears only in the title), staff policies, and short office notes that happen to use the words people ask with.

You control the **retrieval mode** (`bm25` keyword match, `dense` embedding similarity with a pinned bge-small model, or `hybrid`), **hybridAlpha** (in hybrid mode, the weight on the dense score: 0 is pure BM25, 1 is pure dense) and **topK**. Documents are short enough that each one is a single chunk, and every retrieved chunk is sent to the model in full.

The hidden-set breakdown on your scorecard counts hits per question type, so you can see which kind of question your mode misses.

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90 and mean prompt tokens ≤ 250 on the hidden set.

retrievalMode.description: bm25 matches keywords, dense matches meaning with embeddings, hybrid mixes both by hybridAlpha.

hybridAlpha.description: Hybrid only: weight on the dense score (0 = BM25, 1 = dense).
